name: Fladdy / After Harvest YouTube slides (the light set)

rust.role: THE accent: the one word or line that matters

sage.role: a colour field or band (part titles, lists)

spark.role: at most one tiny moment per slide

display.use: headlines and the script line; thickened with a 0.022em text stroke; no punctuation in the demo, so a Literata glyph stands in

display-italic.use: the script word in a headline

sub.use: the small lead-in above a headline, sentence case

body.use: the shout (caps or lowercase) and bold lines

rules: two colours per slide: ink plus rust; sage only as a ground
at most two type voices per slide besides the source line
at most two props per slide, at the edges, never touching the key words
real screenshots and photos as the main visual, source line under each, never taped
the face circle on every slide; things may touch it, nothing covers the key words
